limitations: Parse-only: imports and AST receiver chains provide syntactic evidence, not symbol/type resolution or semantic validation.
Routes are source registration candidates, not complete APIs or proof of runtime registration, reachability, permissions or OpenAPI coverage.
Only literal paths in recognized WebFlux builder chains, route/andRoute predicates and inline path/nest callbacks are resolved.
Constants, computed paths, helper calls, builder aliases/reassignment/control flow and cross-method prefixes are not resolved.
Predicate OR and arbitrary predicate combinations are unresolved; only accept/contentType AND refinements are recognized.
Handler references and declaration signatures retain source spelling; they are not resolved semantic signatures.
Gateway Java DSL and annotation mappings are unresolved candidates; gateway YAML/configuration, runtime/generated routes and WebSocket URL mappings are outside resolved scope.
Candidate discovery is syntactic and can include unrelated same-name calls; unresolved entries are never counted as resolved routes.
Offsets are zero-based UTF-16 with exclusive end; line/column are one-based javac positions.

                        .summary("发起 SSO 认证")
                        .tag("SSO 认证")
                        .parameter(parameterBuilder()
                                .name("providerId")
                                .description("SSO 提供商 ID")
                                .in(ParameterIn.QUERY)
                                .required(true)
                                .example("1"))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("200").description("生成认证请求成功,返回重定向 URL"))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("400").description("参数错误"))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("404").description("SSO 提供商不存在或已禁用")))
                .POST("/auth/sso/callback", authHandler::callback, ops -> ops.operationId("handleSsoCallback")
                        .summary("SSO 回调处理")
                        .tag("SSO 认证")
                        .parameter(parameterBuilder()
                                .name("providerId")
                                .description("SSO 提供商 ID")
                                .in(ParameterIn.QUERY)
                                .required(true))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("200").description("认证成功,返回 JWT 令牌和用户信息"))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("400").description("认证响应参数错误或验证失败"))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("401").description("认证失败,用户身份无效"))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("404").description("SSO 提供商不存在或已禁用")))
                .POST("/auth/sso/logout", authHandler::logout, ops -> ops.operationId("ssoLogout")
                        .summary("SSO 登出")
                        .tag("SSO 认证")
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("200").description("登出成功"))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("401").description("未授权,需要先登录"))
                        .response(responseBuilder().responseCode("404").description("SSO 会话不存在")))
